high_level_description: This image appears to be a screenshot from an Instagram post by the user "rolaghorab." The post shows a woman standing on a balcony with a backdrop of a multi-story building. The building has a beige facade with several windows and air conditioning units attached to them. Some laundry is hanging out to dry on the balconies. The woman is wearing a long, flowing yellow dress with thin straps and a low back. She is posing with her back slightly turned towards the camera, looking over her shoulder. Her hair is dark and pulled back.
